name: io.github.factql/factql-mcp
title: FactQL
description: Verified answers from your data, with the query and rows behind them, or a decline, never a guess.

environmentVariables.name: FACTQL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: FactQL API key (an ask-only key is enough)

environmentVariables.name: FACTQL_WORKSPACE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Default workspace, for tenants that use workspaces

environmentVariables.name: FACTQL_END_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Who is asking; defaults to mcp:<os user>
